settings.title: Server settings (XLSX)
settings.intro: Download the current settings, edit the file and choose it here: the server checks the file and applies it only after your confirmation. The last change can be rolled back.
settings.confirm_apply: Apply the settings on the LIVE server? This changes what reaches the Telegram channels and what is published automatically. Published posts cannot be recalled. Was the 'what changes' probe run?
settings.confirm_rollback: Return the settings to the state before the last apply? This changes the rules of live channels again; published posts stay.
settings.probe_hint: The "what changes in 48 hours" probe still runs on the server: command info xlsx try-pending.
settings.probe_running: The server is calculating on a database copy, a few minutes...
themes.title: Topics: keywords
themes.intro: Choose a topic, edit the words (one per line), check them on a sample headline and save. The change affects new news; the previous state can be rolled back in the 'Settings' tab.
themes.words_hint: One word or phrase per line
themes.syntax: word* - beginning of a word; word! - exactly this form; no mark: up to 4 letters exact, longer without the last one or two letters.
themes.sample_hint: Paste a headline or news text
themes.confirm_save: Save this topic's words on the LIVE server? New news will be sorted by the new words, which may change automatic publication.
themes.rollback_hint: Rollback: 'Settings' tab - 'Roll back the last apply'.
settings.warning: Warning: applying changes the rules of live channels. It decides which news reach the Telegram channels and what is published automatically; a mistake can cause extra or missed posts. Run the 'what changes' probe first. Rollback restores the settings but does not remove posts already published.
themes.warning: Warning: changing words changes which topics and channels new news will reach, so automatic publication may change. Check the words on examples; rollback restores the words but not posts already published.
settings.digest_missing: Could not verify the staged XLSX version. Refresh the settings panel.
settings.confirm_unprobed: No completed matching probe exists for this XLSX. Apply without a probe?
settings.probe_stale: This report may belong to another file or the probe failed. Do not rely on it when applying settings.
settings.probe_valid: This report matches the currently checked XLSX. The probe does not apply any changes.
